item.title: Valdosta Touchdown Club hosts 2025 football awards ceremony
item.description: VALDOSTA – The Valdosta High Touchdown Club held its 2025 Football Awards Ceremony Tuesday night at the VHS Performing Arts Center. This past season, the ‘Cats advanced to the GHSA […]

item.title: Baby rescued, mother detained after mental health incident
item.description: A welfare check on a 39-year-old mother and infant child on Sunday led to a race against time to de-escalate when the mother was found in the middle of a mental health crisis holding a knife.

item.title: Middle South Georgia Conservation District offers feral hog trap rentals
item.description: Feral swine have become increasingly detrimental in Georgia, causing significant damage to agricultural crops and natural resources throughout the state.

item.title: Wiregrass Tech’s Mona Mackenzie named to GEAC board
item.description: The Georgia Education Advancement Council’s Board of Directors recently named its 2026 officers and welcomed new board members.

item.title: Georgia Peanut Commission Research Report Day set for Feb. 4
item.description: The Georgia Peanut Commission will hold the annual Research Report Day, Feb. 4, beginning at 9 a.m. at the National Environmentally Sound Production Agriculture Laboratory (NESPAL), located on the University of Georgia Tifton campus at 2360 Rainwater Road.

item.title: Turner Center for the Arts and VSU host “The Strange Case of Lady Liberty”
item.description: The Annette Howell Turner Center for the Arts, in partnership with Valdosta State University, will present The Strange Case of Lady Liberty, a free America250 program.

item.title: UPDATE: Valdosta woman chosen for Georgia’s WIN List training
item.description: Kristina Cheek, a South Georgia community leader, advocate, and political strategist, has been selected to participate in the Georgia WIN List Leadership Academy.

item.title: Visiting ‘Our Town’: LHS presents the Great American Play
item.description: “Our Town” is one of the most produced plays ever and is often listed in the top 10 American plays of all time.

item.title: FBI raids Fulton County for ballots from Georgia’s close 2020 election
item.description: FBI agents raided Fulton County’s elections warehouse Wednesday to collect ballots from the 2020 presidential election, an escalation by the Trump administration into unsubstantiated allegations of fraud.

item.title: Republican state House leaders unveil plan to abolish homeowner property taxes
item.description: Republicans in Georgia's state House say they want to take steps to erase homeowner property taxes this legislative session, which is getting underway ahead of an election cycle seemingly dominated by concerns about the cost of living.
